fields.name: SMF119LEN
fields.description: Record length. This field and the next field (total of four bytes) form the RDW (record descriptor word). See “Standard SMF Record Header” on page 13-1 for a detailed description.

fields.name: SMF119SEG
fields.description: Segment descriptor (see record length field).

fields.name: SMF119FLG
fields.description: System indicator Bit Meaning When Set 0 New record format 1 Subtypes used 2 Reserved. 3-6 Version indicators* 7 System is running in PR/SM mode.*See “Standard SMF Record Header” on page 13-1 for a detailed description.

fields.name: SMF119RTY
fields.description: Record type 119 77 .

fields.name: SMF119TME
fields.description: Time since midnight, in hundredths of a second, that the record was moved into the SMF buffer.

fields.name: SMF119DTE
fields.description: Date when the record was moved into the SMF buffer, in the form 0cyydddF. See “Standard SMF Record Header” on page 13-1 for a detailed description.

fields.name: SMF119SID
fields.description: System identification (from the SMFPRMxx SID parameter).

fields.name: SMF119SSI
fields.description: Subsystem identification.

fields.name: SMF119STY
fields.description: Record subtype.

fields.name: SMF119TRN
fields.description: Number of triplets in this record. A triplet is a set of three SMF fields (offset/length/number values) that defines a section of the record. The offset is the offset from the RDW.

fields.name: _rsv_26
fields.description: Reserved.

fields.name: SMF119IDOff
fields.description: Offset to TCP/IP identification section from RDW.

fields.name: SMF119IDLen
fields.description: Length of TCP/IP identification section.

fields.name: SMF119IDNum
fields.description: Number of TCP/IP identification sections.

fields.name: SMF119S1Off
fields.description: Offset to first data section

fields.name: SMF119S1Len
fields.description: Length of first data section

fields.name: SMF119S1Num
fields.description: Number of first data sections

fields.name: SMF119TI_SYSName
fields.description: System name from SYSNAME in IEASYSxx

fields.name: SMF119TI_SysplexName
fields.description: Sysplex name from SYSPLEX in COUPLExx

fields.name: SMF119TI_Stack
fields.description: TCP/IP stack name

fields.name: SMF119TI_ReleaseID
fields.description: z/OS Communications Server TCP/IP release identifier

fields.name: SMF119TI_Comp
fields.description: TCP/IP subcomponent (right padded with blanks): FTPC FTP Client FTPS FTP server IP IP layer STACK Entire TCP/IP stack TCP TCP layer TN3270C TN3270 Client TN3270S TN3270 server UDP UDP layer

fields.name: SMF119TI_ASName
fields.description: Started task qualifier or address space name of address space that writes this SMF record

fields.name: SMF119TI_UserID
fields.description: User ID of security context under which this SMF record is written

fields.name: _rsv_56
fields.description: Reserved

fields.name: SMF119TI_ASID
fields.description: ASID of address space that writes this SMF record

fields.name: SMF119TI_Reason
fields.description: Reason for writing this SMF record: X'08' Event record X'C0' Interval statistics record, more records follow X'80' Interval statistics record, last record in set X'60' End-of-statistics record, more records follow X'20' End-of-statistics re

fields.name: _rsv_61
fields.description: Reserved

fields.name: SMF119UD_UCRname
fields.description: UDP socket resource name (address space name of address space that opens this socket)

fields.name: SMF119UD_UCConnID
fields.description: UDP socket resource ID (connection ID)

fields.name: SMF119UD_UCSubTask
fields.description: Subtask ID. This is the task TCB for the task owning the socket.

fields.name: SMF119UD_UCOTime
fields.description: Time of day of socket open

fields.name: SMF119UD_UCODate
fields.description: Date of socket open

fields.name: SMF119UD_UCCTime
fields.description: Time of day of socket close

fields.name: SMF119UD_UCCDate
fields.description: Date of socket close

fields.name: SMF119UD_UCRIP
fields.description: Remote IP of last datagram received on socket

fields.name: SMF119UD_UCLIP
fields.description: Local IP address at time of socket close

fields.name: SMF119UD_UCRPort
fields.description: Remote port of last datagram received on socket

fields.name: SMF119UD_UCLPort
fields.description: Local port number at time of socket close

fields.name: SMF119UD_UCType
fields.description: UDP Socket Type x'01': Standard x'02': Enterprise Extender

fields.name: SMF119UD_UCReason
fields.description: Reason for socket close x'01': Normal x'02': Abnormal: application error or stack termination

fields.name: _rsv_70
fields.description: Reserved

fields.name: SMF119UD_UCInDgrams
fields.description: Number of inbound UDP datagrams

fields.name: SMF119UD_UCOutDgrams
fields.description: Number of outbound UDP datagrams

fields.name: SMF119UD_UCInBytes
fields.description: Number of inbound bytes

fields.name: SMF119UD_UCOutBytes
fields.description: Number of outbound bytes
